customAttributes.description:
Remove this card at the beginning of your turn.

You may play only 1 ability named "RED" each turn. The same is true of abilities named "PURPLE", "YELLOW", and "BLUE."


RED — ENHANCE Remove: Change the zone of your attack.


PURPLE — RESPONSE Remove, spend 1 momentum: After your blocked attack resolves, clear it from your card pool and draw 1 card.


YELLOW — RESPONSE Remove, Spend 1 momentum: Before you take damage from an unblocked attack, change that attack's damage to 3.
BLUE — FORM Remove: Freeze 1 rival foundation.

Enhance: Look at the top card of a player's deck. You may have that player mill 1.

Response: After this backup is attacked, draw 1 card.

(Elusive—This backup cannot be attacked by a rival's first attack each turn.)
